reason: The README describes agent skills that select and run Octoparse web-scraping templates, collect live website data through an MCP-connected cloud service, and export results for research and business workflows.

summaries.zh: 通过 Octoparse 模板和 MCP 服务从实时网站采集数据，并将结果导出供智能体处理。
summaries.en: Uses Octoparse templates and MCP to collect data from live websites and export the results for agent workflows.

capabilities: Collects data from live websites through Octoparse scraping templates
Runs scraping jobs on Octoparse cloud infrastructure
Exports collected rows for downstream use
Connects to and authorizes the Octoparse MCP server
May access user-configured Octoparse tasks and external website data
